blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Food Security Alliance (AFSA) on Saturday launched the ASEAN Food Security Policy Framework and Partnerships, a proposal offering practical ways to address the region’s food security crisis. The framework lays out five priorities: attracting investors for small producers, facilitating regional food trade, financing agricultural infrastructure, strengthening crisis coordination and climate innovation, and protecting land rights and environmental sustainability.
